jobs.title: Geospatial Sales & Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Geospatial Sales \& Marketing Specialist****About the Opportunity****Berry and Associates** is seeking an experienced **Geospatial Sales \& Marketing Specialist** to help expand their business and strengthen their presence across the aerial surveying, LiDAR, photogrammetry, GIS, and geospatial data markets.  

The ideal candidate will have a proven background in selling geospatial services, aerial surveying/mapping solutions, LiDAR, aerial imagery, photogrammetry, GIS, or related technology, and established relationships within the engineering, surveying, transportation, utility, construction, and government sectors. **Key Responsibilities*** Develop and implement sales and marketing strategies to grow our geospatial services.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities and qualified leads.
* Develop and maintain relationships with engineering firms, surveyors, utilities, transportation agencies, municipalities, government agencies, and other potential clients.
* Promote aerial LiDAR, photogrammetry, orthophotography, UAV/drone mapping, mobile LiDAR, GIS, and other geospatial services.
* Prepare proposals, presentations, statements of qualifications, and marketing materials.
* Respond to RFPs, RFQs, and other procurement opportunities.
  

  

Remote candidates located throughout the U.S. will be considered, with a preference for candidates based in the **Southeastern United States**.
